CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_es_admin(p_usuario_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select rol_base in ('dueno','admin') from usuarios where id = p_usuario_id and activo), false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_mi_inmobiliaria()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select inmobiliaria_id from usuarios where id = auth.uid() and activo;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_operaciones_listar()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, tipo text, estado text, parent_id text, datos jsonb, creado_en timestamp with time zone, actualizado_en timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select o.id, o.tipo, o.estado, o.parent_id, o.datos, o.creado_en, o.actualizado_en
  from operaciones o
  where o.inmobiliaria_id = fn_mi_inmobiliaria() and o.eliminado_en is null
  order by o.creado_en desc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_operaciones_papelera()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, tipo text, estado text, parent_id text, datos jsonb, creado_en timestamp with time zone, eliminado_en timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select o.id, o.tipo, o.estado, o.parent_id, o.datos, o.creado_en, o.eliminado_en
  from operaciones o
  where o.inmobiliaria_id = fn_mi_inmobiliaria() and o.eliminado_en is not null
  order by o.eliminado_en desc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_documento_versiones_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_version integer;
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
     and (
       old.datos is distinct from new.datos
       or old.tipo is distinct from new.tipo
       or old.parent_id is distinct from new.parent_id
     ) then
    select coalesce(max(v.version), 0) + 1
      into v_version
      from public.documento_versiones v
     where v.operacion_id = old.id;

    insert into public.documento_versiones (
      inmobiliaria_id,
      operacion_id,
      version,
      tipo_documento,
      documento,
      creado_por
    )
    values (
      old.inmobiliaria_id,
      old.id,
      v_version,
      old.tipo,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', old.id,
        'tipo', old.tipo,
        'estado', old.estado,
        'parent_id', old.parent_id,
        'datos', old.datos,
        'creado_en', old.creado_en,
        'actualizado_en', old.actualizado_en,
        'actualizado_por', old.actualizado_por
      ),
      coalesce(new.actualizado_por, old.actualizado_por)
    );
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
datos.definicion: CREATE TRIGGER trg_documento_versiones_snapshot AFTER UPDATE ON public.operaciones FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_documento_versiones_snapshot()
